names: UCSF Medical Center at Mission Bay
summary: A 289-bed, six-story integrated hospital complex at 1975 4th St combining UCSF Benioff Children's Hospital, UCSF Bakar Cancer Hospital and Betty Irene Moore Women's Hospital under one roof, which opened February 1, 2015 after roughly 10 years of planning and 5 years of construction.

milestones.text: UC Regents Committee on Grounds and Buildings certifies the project EIR, approves LRDP Amendment #3, and approves the design, site plan and financial plan for the UCSF Medical Center at Mission Bay -- this hospital specifically, per the item's own site plan (Attachment, p.15) laying out the hospital buildings, parking and phase boundary; the September 17, 2008 certification date is corroborated by a later (2009) Regents item recounting it
UCSF Medical Center at Mission Bay opens

facts.value: Anshen+Allen (architect of record, later absorbed into Stantec); design collaborator William McDonough + Partners
289 total (183-bed UCSF Benioff Children's Hospital, 36-bed Betty Irene Moore Women's Hospital, 70-bed UCSF Bakar Cancer Hospital)
Acute-care hospital: pediatric, women's, and cancer care

images.appeal_note: Clean, high-resolution key plan labelling the hospital buildings, parking and phase boundary against the street grid and Mariposa Park with a phase legend, legible even shrunk, but it's a grayscale massing/phasing diagram rather than a color-coded program plan.
